report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 63-94ms durations; traces show healthy spans across inventory, payment, order and postgres, and metrics show zero 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~98ms. No fault is established by current evidence; the alert reflects normal latency. Operator hypothesis of a fault is contradicted by healthy telemetry, so hand off rather than assert a bounded cause.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency SLO/threshold for /v1/checkout to judge whether 63-94ms is anomalous
Sustained time-series of checkout latency and error rates beyond the 60s window
Dependency-level latency/error metrics for order, payment, inventory, redis, postgres
Any error logs or non-200 responses correlated with the alert window
